_note: The comment thread of a held agent PR in REST shape — exactly what GET /repos/{repo}/issues/{n}/comments returns, which is the payload fix_context parses and the ONLY shape that carries user.type (DRE-3451: the sweep re-fetches over REST for this reason, and the comment-triggered gate has to read the same thing). Written from PR #2365's 2026-09-08 sequence as recorded on DRE-3451 — decision posted 16:13 PT, restart 16:28 PT — with the pipeline's own bodies abridged to the lines the predicates key on. It is a reconstruction of that timeline, not a byte-for-byte capture of the API response.
